    AI Overview
    Arslanbek Makhmudov is a Russian-Canadian professional heavyweight boxer with a 21-2 record (19 KOs) as of April 2026. Known for his high knockout ratio, the "Lion" has notable wins over Carlos Takam and David Allen, with his only defeats coming against top contenders Agit Kabayel and Guido Vianello. 
    Key Record Stats (as of April 2026): 
    • Record: 21-2-0 (Wins-Losses-Draws)
    • Wins by Knockout: 19
    • KO Percentage: ~90.48%
    • Stance: Orthodox 
    Recent Fights: 
    • Oct 11, 2025: Won vs. David Allen (UD-12)
    • Aug 17, 2024: Lost vs. Guido Vianello (TKO-8)
    • May 25, 2024: Won vs. Miljan Rovcanin (KO-2)
    • Dec 23, 2023: Lost vs. Agit Kabayel (TKO-4) 
    Makhmudov is known for his aggressive style and punching power, often fighting in Quebec, Canada.
